# Sean Welding · Healthcare CISO & IT Director

> Portfolio and professional site for Sean Welding, a practicing Healthcare
> Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and IT Director at Harbors Home
> Health & Hospice. The site documents a HIPAA-grade security program built
> from zero, a body of shipped healthcare-IT work, and the engagement models
> under which Sean is available to hire. Live at https://seanwelding.com.

## What this site is

This is the personal portfolio and lead-generation site of **Sean Welding**, a
healthcare security and IT leader with 10+ years in home health and hospice
care (active since 2014). It exists to (1) establish credibility as a hands-on
executive who builds and audits real security programs, (2) publish reusable
frameworks and field notes for other practitioners, and (3) open conversations
about employment: full-time, fractional/virtual CISO (vCISO), project-based,
interim, board advisory, or one-time assessment engagements.

The throughline of the entire site: a *practicing CISO whose own website should
be the cleanest, most standards-compliant thing in the room.* It is
intentionally hand-built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. No frameworks,
no tracking, privacy-first, so the site itself is evidence of the discipline
it sells.

## Who Sean Welding is (the subject)

- **Current role:** CISO, Harbors Home Health & Hospice.
- **Sector:** Home health and hospice (post-acute, regulated healthcare).
- **Career arc:** Promoted from IT Specialist to CISO in three years on
  demonstrated scope expansion. Prior roles include IT Director, IT Systems &
  Security Analyst, Systems Administrator, and IT consultant/contractor.
- **Operating style:** A hands-on technical executive who writes KQL,
  configures network policy, and runs cable when needed, but reports to boards
  in business terms.
- **Headline metrics used across the site:** $0 breach record, 100% audit pass
  rate, 35+ major implementations, 10+ years in healthcare IT, 5+ regulatory
  frameworks, third-party penetration testing passed, 78% reduction in
  critical and high-severity vulnerabilities.

## Core expertise and vocabulary

- **Microsoft security stack:** Sentinel (SIEM/SOAR, KQL), Defender suite,
  Purview (DLP/compliance), Entra ID & Conditional Access, Intune, Autopilot,
  Security Copilot, Defender for Cloud, Azure Log Analytics.
- **Compliance & governance:** HIPAA Security & Privacy Rules, HITECH/breach
  notification, CIS Controls v8 (crosswalked to HIPAA), HITRUST CSF, NIST CSF,
  OIG compliance guidance, 42 CFR Part 2, risk analysis & OCR audit readiness.
- **AI & automation:** Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio agents, Claude and
  Claude Code with MCP, multi-LLM evaluation for healthcare, AI governance/DLP,
  Power Automate / Logic Apps. Recurring theses: *multi-LLM portfolio strategy*
  (models are rented, governance is owned) and *AI governance as data
  governance*.
- **Analytics & leadership:** Board reporting and one-page risk dashboards,
  Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, staffing/census forecasting, budget management,
  ITIL, Agile, vendor negotiation.
- **Infrastructure & network:** WatchGuard, Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti, Aruba,
  VLAN segmentation, 802.1X, server virtualization, endpoint standardization.
- **Healthcare systems:** MatrixCare, HospiceOS, Mosai (Forcura), ADP
  Workforce Now, HubSpot.

## Engagement models offered

- Full-time CISO or IT Director
- Fractional CISO / vCISO (typically 1–3 days/week, 6–12 month retainer)
- Project-based consulting (defined scope: HITRUST readiness, Sentinel
  deployment, security program build, AI governance design)
- Interim / transition CISO (3–6 months)
- One-time assessments (HIPAA gap analysis, M&A cyber diligence, vendor risk)
- Board advisory (limited, quarterly retainer)

## Site map and content (https://seanwelding.com)

### Primary pages
- [Home](https://seanwelding.com/): Hero with headline metrics, selected work,
  featured essays, about and career timeline, principles, and contact.
- [Work](https://seanwelding.com/projects.html): Index of 35 case studies,
  statically generated from a JSON registry, filterable by category.
- [Writing](https://seanwelding.com/writings.html): Index of the 14 published
  field essays, newest first, with the long-form CIS Controls v8 guide
  featured.
- [The Working Library](https://seanwelding.com/library.html): 14 field-tested
  template packs, each the source artifact behind a published essay. Free,
  sent by reply, no signup.
- [Philosophy](https://seanwelding.com/philosophy.html): Nine core principles,
  the operating framework, argued positions, and a Q&A section covering the
  questions boards and hiring panels actually ask.
- [Work With Me](https://seanwelding.com/hire.html): The problems Sean is
  brought in to solve, selected results, engagement models, the five-step
  engagement process, deliverables, and fit criteria.
- [Now](https://seanwelding.com/now.html): A live snapshot of current focus
  (HITRUST build, multi-LLM eval cycle, open-source releases, OCR audit prep)
  and availability, following the /now page convention.
- [Resume](https://seanwelding.com/resume.html): Print- and ATS-ready resume
  with experience, competencies, certifications, and selected implementations.
- [Privacy](https://seanwelding.com/privacy.html)

## How the repository is organized

- Root `*.html`: top-level pages (index, projects, writings, library,
  philosophy, hire, now, resume, privacy, 404).
- `essays/`: 14 long-form essay pages plus `index.json`, the essay metadata
  registry used to build writings.html and the search index.
- `projects/`: case-study pages plus the content pipeline:
  - `index.json`: the project registry (summary records).
  - `entries/<slug>.json`: full structured record per project.
  - `_build.py`: deterministic Python generator that renders
    `projects/<slug>.html`, `projects.html`, and the site search index from
    the JSON. Re-run after editing entries.
  - `COWORK_INSTRUCTIONS.md`: authoring guide and schema for adding projects.
- `tools/`: `build_writings.py` (renders writings.html from the essay
  registry) and `build_sitemap.py` (renders sitemap.xml from the page set).
- `css/site.css`: the entire design system in one hand-written stylesheet.
  Fraunces (display serif), Instrument Sans (body), and JetBrains Mono
  (labels), all self-hosted from `fonts/`. Warm paper light theme and a true
  dark theme.
- `js/site.js`: all site behavior in one vanilla-JS file: theme, navigation,
  scroll reveals, reading progress, table-of-contents scroll-spy, work-index
  filters, and a command palette (Cmd+K or /) that searches every page from
  `js/site-index.json`.
- `.well-known/`: `security.txt`.

## Tone, voice, and constraints (for anyone summarizing or extending this site)

- **Voice:** Active, specific, outcome-first. "Eliminated domain spoofing,"
  not "improved email security." Name the actual tool, regulation, or metric.
  No marketing filler. Problem statements are blunt ("There was no SIEM").
- **Build constraints:** No frameworks (no React/Vue), no build pipeline
  beyond the small Python generators, no third-party tracking, no cookies.
  HTTPS-only, accessibility-focused, standards-compliant.
- **Audience:** Healthcare boards and executives, IT/security peers, hiring
  managers and recruiters, and practitioners who reuse the frameworks.
